Cosmetics.metaDescription: Personalised skincare and home care recommendations at Beauty Room following a consultation or treatment, based on your skin type and condition. Tel Aviv–Yafo.
Cosmetics.title: Skincare selected for your skin
Cosmetics.lead: Finding suitable skincare is easier when you understand what your skin needs. At Beauty Room, a specialist will help you choose skincare products after a consultation or treatment, taking into account your skin type, its current condition and your preferences.
Cosmetics.care1: Dryness, excess shine, sensitivity and tightness are reasons to review your usual skincare routine. Choosing products depends on both your skin type and its current condition.
Cosmetics.care2: During your consultation, tell us which products you already use, what you like and which products cause discomfort. This will help the specialist suggest a clear home skincare routine.
Cosmetics.afterTitle: What should you use after a treatment?
Cosmetics.after1: After <procedures>cosmetic treatments</procedures>, your skin’s needs may differ from usual. Your specialist will explain which products are suitable during this period, how to use them and when you can return to your usual routine.
Cosmetics.after2: Discuss cleansing, moisturising, sun protection and additional products if needed. Recommendations are tailored to the treatment you have had and your skin’s response.
Cosmetics.consult: Not sure where to start or what to add to your skincare routine? Contact Beauty Room for advice or to book a treatment.

AccessibilityPage.text3: Beauty Room is working to make its website accessible to people with different needs. Our reference points are Israeli Standard SI 5568 and the WCAG AA guidelines. A full compliance assessment has not yet been completed, so we do not claim verified AA compliance for the entire website.
AccessibilityPage.text4: The website offers text enlargement up to 200%, spacing adjustments, Arial font, contrast modes, inverted colours and greyscale, link and heading highlighting, motion controls, an enlarged cursor and a reading guide. Settings are saved in your browser and can be reset in the accessibility menu.
AccessibilityPage.text5: The accessibility menu button is at the bottom right of the page. Use Tab and Shift + Tab to move between elements, Enter to open links, and Enter or Space to activate buttons. Press Esc to close the menu. A skip-to-content link appears at the top of the page when focused using the keyboard. Keyboard navigation on macOS may differ depending on your browser and settings.
AccessibilityPage.text7: The widget helps you adjust the display but does not replace content accessibility checks. Videos may lack captions or a text description. Third-party services, including WhatsApp, Instagram and maps, operate outside our website. If any content is inaccessible, contact the coordinator: we will help you obtain the information and book in a way that works for you.
AccessibilityPage.text10: The salon is physically accessible to visitors with limited mobility.
AccessibilityPage.text11: There is no separate toilet in the salon.
AccessibilityPage.text12: Regular parking is available. There are no designated accessible parking spaces.
AccessibilityPage.text13: Before your visit, contact the coordinator to clarify entrance arrangements and any assistance you may need.
AccessibilityPage.text16: Please provide the page address, a description of the difficulty and your preferred contact method. If possible, include your browser and device so that we can reproduce the problem.
AccessibilityPage.description: Accessibility of the Beauty Room website and salon. Accessibility settings and contact details for coordinator Adam Kanter.
